purpose.zh: 练大腿前侧和臀部，提升下蹲能力
purpose.en: Build the thighs and glutes and improve your squat.

text.zh: 臀部向后坐，膝盖对准脚尖
text.en: Sit your hips back and keep your knees over your toes

text.zh: 脚跟始终踩地，胸口保持抬起
text.en: Keep your heels down and your chest up.

text.zh: 下蹲到大腿约与地面平行，再用脚掌推地站起
text.en: Lower until your thighs are about parallel, then push through your feet to stand.

commonErrors.zh: 脚跟离地、重心压到脚尖
commonErrors.en: Lifting the heels and shifting the weight onto the toes.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
